title: 第一章 神秘空间
slug: 武神空间全本免费-武神空间最新章节列表
content_zh:
一片不是很大的小湖泊边上，一个约莫着十七八岁的青衣少年坐在湖边，抓起湖边的一块石头扔出，顿时在湖边打出几朵浪花。
叶希文有些茫然，他没想到，他居然穿越了，原本叶希文只是二十一世纪的地球上一个普通的大学生罢了，一个月了，他才终于接受了穿越的事实，这不是有人和他进行恶作剧，而是，他真的穿越了。
到了这个世界已经一个多月了，他慢慢的也能接受事实了，这里已经不是在地球了，虽然这里的风土人情和古中国很像，但是他知道，这里已经不是地球了，而是一个叫真武界的地方。
这是一个武道的世界，一个武技繁衍了无数年的世界，武技在这个世界繁衍出了灿烂的文明，强大的武者修为达到绝顶可以移山倒海，开山裂石，甚至寿命无限延长。
叶希文现在的身份，就是一元宗中的一位长老的第三子，而且还是养子，是父亲叶空明在十八年前抱回来的，这在宗里都不算什么秘密。
一元宗是大越国最为强盛的门派之一，高手如云。
而坐落在青峰山上的一元宗只是大越国一元宗的其中一个分支罢了，像这样的分支一元宗还有很多，专门为一元宗总宗输送人才。
叶希文的修为只在后天三重，以他的年纪，这修为只能算是一般。
在真武界中，武者从踏入武道开始就是后天一重，一直往上，直到后天九重，至于后天之上的，就是先天，至于先天怎么划分的，叶希文就不知道了，毕竟一元宗的宗主也才是先天境界呢。
一元宗一共分外门，内门，核心三个级别的弟子，当到了核心弟子级别之后，便能够前往一元宗总宗参加考核，考核过的人，就能够真正拜入一元宗。
一元宗弟子的层次并非按照年纪来划分的，而是按照实力来划分的，后天肉身九境，能修炼到第三重境界之后，就能从外门升入内门，当修炼到第五重之后，就能够晋入到核心了，而如果想去参加一元宗总宗的考核，起码的要求也是第七重。
要求不可谓不高，叶希文的前身资质平平，今年十八岁，但是修为却也只是刚刚修炼到第三重后期罢了，这种成绩虽然不算奇差，不过也只能算是一般了。
叶希文也只是一元宗内门弟子中很普通的一个，内门弟子虽然不比核心弟子尊贵，但是也不像外门弟子一般地位低下，再加上他的父亲乃是一元宗中的长老，因此平日里他过的也还算不错。
不过他也算不上太受重视，叶希文的前身资质太过普通，后天三重后期在内门弟子中也只能算是中间，尤其是和两个哥哥姐姐相比，就更是如此了，他的大哥叶枫今年不过是二十一岁，就已经是后天八重巅峰，是宗里的超级天才，而他的二姐叶茹雪只比他大一岁多，也已经是后天七重的存在了。
在这样的情况下，他当然不怎么受到关注！
“沙沙！”
叶希文身后的树林中传来一阵沙沙声，一个十七八岁的锦衣胖子从树丛后蹿了出来，叶希文脸上露出几分笑容，这人名叫王烈，是他从小到大的好友，家里是青峰山下青峰镇上的一家大户人家，和一元宗有很深的关系，王烈自小也就被送上山学武，两人关系极好。
当然，他们俩天分半斤八两，叶希文是三重后期，王烈也就比叶希文强点儿，三重巅峰，这也是两人一直处的很好的原因。
“天色都晚了，你不回去歇着，来这里干什么？”叶希文笑着问道。
“这不是不放心你么？”王烈嘿嘿一笑说道。“你最近老是怪怪的，神神叨叨的！”

“放心吧，我能有什么事儿！”叶希文说道。
无非就是从地球穿越过来有些不适应罢了！
“你现在正是要突破到四重的关键时候，还不赶紧闭关！”叶希文说道，后天三重只能算是内门弟子中普通的，但是后天四重就算是内门弟子中的精英了，虽然只差一重，但是地位都天差地别。
“嘿嘿，我来找你就是为了这事儿，我打算闭关，大概要一段时间，不过你最近神神叨叨的，我有些放心不下！”王烈有些担心的看着叶希文说道，从小和叶希文一起长大，虽然两人一贯打打闹闹，但是却是非常关心他这个兄弟的，当然他永远都想不到，他的兄弟已经换人了。

content_en:
On the edge of a small lake that was not very big, a young man in green clothes, about seventeen or eighteen years old, was sitting on the edge of the lake. He grabbed a stone from the lake and threw it, causing a few waves to hit the lake.
Ye Xiwen was a little confused. He didn't expect that he actually traveled through time. Originally, Ye Xiwen was just an ordinary college student on the earth in the 21st century. It took a month for him to finally accept the fact that he had traveled through time. This was not because someone was playing a prank on him, but because he had really traveled through time.
It has been more than a month since he arrived in this world, and he has slowly come to accept the fact that this place is no longer on Earth. Although the customs and customs here are very similar to those of ancient China, he knows that this is no longer Earth, but a place called Zhenwu Realm.
This is a world of martial arts, a world where martial arts have flourished for countless years. Martial arts have spawned a splendid civilization in this world. A powerful warrior who has reached the peak of his cultivation can move mountains and seas, break mountains and crack rocks, and even extend his lifespan indefinitely.
Ye Xiwen's current identity is the third son of an elder in the Yiyuan Sect, and he is also an adopted son. He was brought back by his father Ye Kongming eighteen years ago. This is not a secret in the sect.
The Yiyuan Sect is one of the most powerful sects in Dayue Kingdom, with many masters.
The Yiyuan Sect located on Qingfeng Mountain is just one branch of the Yiyuan Sect in Dayue Kingdom. There are many branches like this Yiyuan Sect, which specialize in providing talents for the main Yiyuan Sect.
Ye Xiwen's cultivation level is only at the third level of acquired cultivation. Considering his age, this cultivation level can only be regarded as average.
In the true martial arts world, a warrior starts from the first level of acquired martial arts, and goes up to the ninth level of acquired heaven. As for what is above acquired, it is innate. As for how innate is divided, Ye Xiwen doesn't know. After all, the leader of Yiyuan Sect is also in the innate realm.
There are three levels of disciples in the Yiyuan Sect: outer sect, inner sect, and core disciples. After reaching the core disciple level, they can go to the main sect of the Yiyuan Sect to take the assessment. Those who pass the assessment can truly join the Yiyuan Sect.
The levels of disciples of the Yiyuan Sect are not divided by age, but by strength. After cultivating the ninth level of the acquired physical body to the third level, you can advance from the outer sect to the inner sect. After you reach the fifth level, you can advance to the core. If you want to take the assessment of the main sect of the Yiyuan Sect, the minimum requirement is the seventh level.
The requirements are not too high. Ye Xiwen's previous qualifications were mediocre. He was eighteen years old this year, but his cultivation had only just reached the late third level. Although this kind of performance was not particularly bad, it could only be regarded as average.
Ye Xiwen is just an ordinary disciple among the inner disciples of the Yiyuan Sect. Although the inner disciples are not more noble than the core disciples, they are not as low-status as the outer disciples. In addition, his father is an elder in the Yiyuan Sect, so he lives a pretty good life on weekdays.
However, he is not too valued. Ye Xiwen's previous qualifications are too ordinary, and he can only be regarded as the middle among the inner disciples in the late acquired third level, especially compared with his two older brothers and sisters. His eldest brother Ye Feng is only twenty-one years old this year, and is already the peak of the eighth level acquired, a super genius in the sect, while his second sister Ye Ruxue is only more than one year older than him, and is already at the seventh level acquired.
Under such circumstances, he certainly doesn't get much attention!
"Shasha!"
There was a rustle in the woods behind Ye Xiwen, and a fat man in brocade clothes who was about 17 or 18 years old jumped out from behind the trees. Ye Xiwen had a smile on his face. This man's name was Wang Lie, and he had been his friend since childhood. His family was a wealthy family in Qingfeng Town at the foot of Qingfeng Mountain. They had a deep relationship with the Yiyuan Sect. Wang Lie had been sent to the mountain to learn martial arts since he was a child, and the two had a very good relationship.
Of course, the two of them are equally talented. Ye Xiwen is at the late third level, and Wang Lie is just a little better than Ye Xiwen, at the peak of the third level.This is the reason why the two of them have always gotten along well.
"It's getting late. If you don't go back and rest, what are you doing here?" Ye Xiwen asked with a smile.
"Aren't you worried about this?" Wang Lie said with a smile. "You've been acting weird lately, and you're so nagging!"
"Don't worry, what can happen to me!" Ye Xiwen said.
It’s just that I’m not used to it after traveling from Earth!
"Now is the critical time for you to break through to the fourth level, why don't you retreat quickly!" Ye Xiwen said. The acquired third level can only be regarded as ordinary among the inner disciples, but the acquired fourth level is considered to be the elite among the inner disciples. Although there is only one level difference, the status is very different.
"Hey, that's why I came to you. I plan to go into seclusion for a while, but you've been nagging me so much lately that I'm a little worried!" Wang Lie looked at Ye Xiwen with some worry and said. He grew up with Ye Xiwen since childhood. Although the two always fight and fight, they care about his brother very much. Of course, he never thought that his brother had changed.
